svg.desc: A two-by-two grid. The horizontal axis is whether the answer is right; the vertical axis is whether the path was sane. Right answer with a sound method is working. Wrong on both is broken and loud. The dangerous quadrant is a right answer reached by a wrong path - a lucky pass, which an outcome-only test suite reports as success.
